page_title: NOT 1-1 BOU | Nottingham Forest v Bournemouth 17/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bournemouth.
90+2' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
86' 1 - 1 Goal! 1:1. Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.
84' Here is a change. Lewis Cook is going off and Andoni Iraola gives the last tactical orders to Philip Billing (Bournemouth).
82' Harry Toffolo (Nottingham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
80' It seemed like Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
78' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bournemouth.
73' Substitution. Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) in, Callum Hudson-Odoi out.
72' The referee allows time for a substitution. Chris Wood will be replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
69' Substitution. Dango Ouattara leaves the pitch and is replaced by Daniel Jebbison (Bournemouth).
67' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Michael Oliver has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
64' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Luis Sinisterra and he is replaced by Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Smith leaves the pitch and Julian Araujo (Bournemouth) comes on.
63' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Alex Scott.
63' The corner is swung in but Nottingham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

62' Willy Boly (Nottingham) jumps for a header from the resulting corner kick and sends the ball in on goal, but the goalkeeper makes a very good save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nottingham.
62' Corner kick. Nottingham will have an opportunity.
60' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
59' Dangerous play by Chris Wood (Nottingham). Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
56' A cross from a corner kick by Bournemouth is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
54' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Anthony Elanga walks off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
54' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Ola Aina will be replaced by Harry Toffolo (Nottingham).
51' Ola Aina (Nottingham) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
49' Neco Williams (Nottingham) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' Yellow card. Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+13' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+12' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+12' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top right corner only for Matz Sels to dive and make a save.
45+10' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Nottingham players are visibly unhappy with the call.
45+9' There's a break in play and referee Michael Oliver must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Nottingham using VAR. This could be interesting!
45+9' Luis Sinisterra (Bournemouth) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Matz Sels. Now Bournemouth have a corner.
45+7' Bournemouth win a corner.
45+4' Ola Aina (Nottingham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
45+2' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) is caught offside!
45' 11 additional min. will be played.
43' The ball possession at the moment is 62:38.
42' Neco Williams (Nottingham) had time and space on the edge of the box but sent his effort just over the bar.
40' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
37' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle.
35' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Bournemouth players look gutted.
34' The Bournemouth players halt their celebrations as referee Michael Oliver makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
32' Goal! 1:1. The ball rebounds to Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) after a melee in the box, and he easily beats the keeper from close range.
31' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) steps up to send the ball in.

31' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) found himself in a promising position. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made a decent save.
29' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Neto easily deals with the threat.

27' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Michael Oliver with no other option than to blow for a foul.
25' Dean Huijsen (Bournemouth) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Oliver interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
23' 1 - 0 Goal! Chris Wood (Nottingham) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
23' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Neto anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
22' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Neto, who smothers the ball.
19' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
17' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
15' Danilo (Nottingham) just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Ryan Yates replaces him.
12' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
10' The game is interrupted now, Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
9' Danilo (Nottingham) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee decides to stop play.
8' Danilo (Nottingham) commits a rough foul. Michael Oliver stops the game and makes a call.

6' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
5' Bournemouth are seeing far more of the ball now.
3' The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Bournemouth will take the kick-off.
Michael Oliver will supervise the game today.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
